description: This file contains unit tests for the SearchDefsDocumentifier class in SuiteCRM, focusing on its methods for field identification and documentification of contacts and accounts.

classes.name: SearchDefsDocumentifierTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the functionalities of SearchDefsDocumentifier.

methods.name: testGetFieldsToIndex
methods.description: Tests the getFieldsToIndex method for correct field retrieval based on the module and parser.

methods.name: testDocumentifyContact
methods.description: Tests the documentify method with a Contact bean, verifying proper field extraction and structuring.

methods.name: testDocumentifyAccount
methods.description: Tests the documentify method with an Account bean, verifying proper field extraction and structuring.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Provides a mock set of field configurations for a given module.

methods.name: getExpectedFields
methods.description: Defines the expected fields structure after processing for comparison in tests.

methods.name: getMockParser
methods.description: Creates a mock parser object configured to return specific search fields for a module.
